renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Short words. Concrete images. No jargon, no Sanskrit terms, no meta-commentary.

paragraphs.text: Rest knowing on the middle of the tongue, mouth open — shape the breath-letter H with the mind alone, and melt into calm. Picture your own body with no seat under it — mind spent on the vision, and in a flash the dirt in you wastes away.

Rock on a moving seat, or stand rock-still while the body sways — mind gone calm: goddess, the god-flood is won. Stare at the stainless sky without one break in the gaze — stunned to the bone, that very moment the Bhairava-form is won.

Melt the crown till sky is all, all as Bhairava — that all: the blaze of his form-reality walks in. Know something in two lights, then in darkness again — his universe-form, the one that wears endless light, stands known.

On a bad night, in the dark half of the month, sit long in it — stare into the murk, and his form will come. Shut the eyes first with blackness before them — spread his form there, and turn made-of-that.

Strike any sense or block it — step into the not-two open right there: the self shines in that very place. No drop, no outpour — one lone A-sound rises sudden: goddess, a flood of knowing, the highest Lord.

renders.prompt: Render the argument of this song in a Gen-Z voice: direct, a little feral, zero cringe, no slang overload. Keep every doctrinal claim intact — voice changes, content does not. No new doctrines, no comparisons, no meta-commentary, no quoted terms.

paragraphs.text: Knowing parked mid-tongue, mouth open — mind-shaping the H-sound till it melts to calm. Your own body, no seat, pure vision — mind burned on it and the grime burns off in a flash.
Moving seat, standing still, body in motion — mind calmed and goddess takes the god-flood. Sky-gaze with zero cuts — stunned self, same moment, Bhairava-form bagged.
Crown melted, sky everything, everything Bhairava — all of that: his blaze-form reality moves in. Two-light knowing, then dark again — universe-form rocking endless light, clocked.
Bad night, dark fortnight, long sit — murk-staring till his form pulls up. Eyes shut first, blackness up front — his form spread wide, made-of-that mode on.
Smack any sense or seal it — walk into the not-two open on the spot: self shines right there. No drop, no emission, one lone A popping off sudden — knowing-flood, top Lord, goddess.
